headline: Asian shares fell on Thursday as bond markets weakened and reports of big tech borrowing added to the pressure.
score_reason: Daily market wrap with modest moves; the tech-debt link is reported, not confirmed. Lowered from 7 because the pool headline overstates the AI-debt effect.
importance_line: It matters most to investors, since borrowing costs are rising and the reported tech debt deals would compete for the same money, though this is one day's market moves and the tech borrowing is only reported.
summary: Reuters reports that Asian shares slid on Thursday as government bond markets came under strain, partly because some major tech companies are reportedly seeking billions of dollars in new debt. Oil prices rose again on more attacks on shipping in the Gulf, and the euro fell to near a 17-month low over worries about France's finances.
notes: Reuters page blocked (401). Read on Lufkin Daily News, which carries the Reuters wire (Reuters credit kept). Score lowered 7 to 6: the pool headline ('submerged in tide of AI debt') overstates the link, which the wire only reports.
